_comment: Deployment target hosts. The addresses below are RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 documentation addresses and are deliberately non-routable — replace them with your own hosts before deploying.

development.description: Testing server for development branch before production

ssh_setup._public_key_comment: Generate your own key pair with: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/sleuth_servers -C sleuth-servers — then append the resulting .pub contents to each server's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
